Pakperk Community Guidelines

Version: 2026-07-31 Publication status: release-candidate text; public deployment and final Trust & Safety/store review remain external release gates.

Pakperk comments are public observations about papers. Be specific, civil, and useful to other readers. Disagreement and criticism are welcome; abuse is not.

Do not post or facilitate:

  • harassment, bullying, targeted abuse, or dogpiling;
  • hateful or dehumanizing content about protected characteristics;
  • threats, praise or instructions for violence, or encouragement of self-harm;
  • sexual exploitation, sexual content involving minors, or non-consensual intimate material;
  • private identifying information, doxxing, credential theft, or stalking;
  • illegal goods, malicious code, fraud, or instructions intended to cause real-world harm;
  • spam, repetitive promotion, deceptive links, or manipulation;
  • impersonation or misleading claims of affiliation;
  • copyright abuse or other rights violations; or
  • attempts to evade moderation or repeatedly recreate suspended accounts.

Do not paste private peer-review material, unpublished confidential work, or large copyrighted passages. Link to the source and add your own observation. Comments are not private notes and may be reviewed by moderators.

Use Report comment for content problems and Report user for account-level behavior. A report is private to the moderation team and does not block anyone. Use Block user separately to remove an author from your own view. For urgent safety, privacy, copyright, or legal issues, follow the support route and include the comment ID—not the full comment body—when possible.

Moderators may reject, hold, hide, restore, or delete comments and may suspend or reinstate accounts. Actions are audited. Repeated or severe violations can lead to account suspension. The moderation runbook defines response ownership and escalation.

Pakperk 社区指南

版本: 2026-07-31 发布状态: release-candidate 文本；公共部署和最终 信任与安全/商店评论仍为外部发布门。

Pakperk 的评论是对论文的公开观察。请具体、文明，并对其他读者有用。欢迎提出异议和批评；但禁止滥用。

不要发布或协助：

  • 人身攻击、欺凌、有针对性的虐待或围攻；
  • 关于受保护特征的仇恨或去人性化内容；
  • 威胁、赞扬或暴力指示，或鼓励自残；
  • 性剥削、涉及未成年人的性内容，或非自愿的亲密材料；
  • 私人识别信息、网络钓鱼、凭证盗窃或跟踪；
  • 非法商品、恶意代码、欺诈或旨在造成现实世界伤害的指示；
  • 电子邮件垃圾信息、重复推广、欺骗性链接或操纵；
  • 恶意冒充或误导性声称隶属关系；
  • 版权滥用或其他权利侵犯；或
  • 试图规避审核或重复创建被暂停的账户。

不要粘贴私人同行评审材料、未发表的机密工作或大段受版权保护的内容。请链接到来源并添加您自己的观察。评论不是私人笔记，可能被管理员审查。

使用“报告评论”来处理内容问题，使用“报告用户”来处理账户层面的行为。报告仅对审核团队私有，不会阻止任何人。使用“阻止用户”单独操作以从您的视图中移除作者。对于紧急的安全、隐私、版权或法律 问题，请遵循 支持路线，并在可能的情况下包含评论 ID——而不是完整的评论正文。

管理员可能会拒绝、保留、隐藏、恢复或删除评论，可能会暂停或恢复账户。操作会受到审计。重复或严重的违规行为可能导致账户暂停。审核操作手册 定义了响应责任和升级流程。
